title: Local supplied-tensorator shift gauge on flat telescope models
statement: Let f: Z → Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with module-sheaf derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], F = derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback] supplied with a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback H [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put Q = Qh_Y and G = H followed by Qh_Z. Let ε: Q⋙F → G exhibit F as a left derived functor, and give F a coherent integer shift for which ε commutes with shifts. Put Ctel(X) = flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. There exist e: F(O_Y[1]) ≅ O_Z[1] and isomorphisms r_X: (Q⋙F)(X) ≅ (Q⋙F)(X) for X satisfying Ctel, such that (Q⋙F)(s);r_Xprime = r_X;(Q⋙F)(s) whenever s:X→Xprime is a stage-induced map [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] between such representatives. For every literal flat telescope P and X=q(P), r_(X[1]);commShift_(Q⋙F)(X) = F(commShift_Q(X));b(Q(X));r_X[1], where b(K) = F(c_Y(K) inverse);δ_F(O_Y[1],K);(e tensor id);c_Z(F(K)), and c is the canonical shifted-unit comparison [def-sc-scheme-canonical-shift-unit-iso]. No natural transformation on all homotopy objects, or naturality for arbitrary morphisms between model representatives, is asserted.

source.place: lem-sc-flat-telescope-shift-gauge, steps 1–2 and the model-ratio clause of step 3; supplied-tensorator normalization is the agent expansion inherited from lem-sc-normalized-flat-telescope-stage-comparison. Stacks Tags 06YS and 06YJ supply the flat models only.

proof.text: Apply bounded-flat model normalization to obtain e and beta, then extend the supplied normalization through sums and transition cones. This gives model isomorphisms alpha from Qh followed by derived pullback to the termwise pullback localization, natural for stage maps and satisfying the normalized shift square.

Prove the supplied counit epsilon invertible on every literal telescope: K-flat closure gives K-flatness, and its comparison to the recorded left-derived counit is an isomorphism by the universal property. The factorization of this lift identifies epsilon at a K-flat object with a composite of isomorphisms. For shifted representatives use NatTrans.shift_app_comm and the inverse shift comparisons to express the shifted component as a composite of isomorphisms.

Set a_X = alpha_X followed by the inverse of epsilon_X. Postcompose the desired naturality equality with epsilon_Xprime and cancel; epsilon naturality and alpha stage naturality prove the square. For the gauge shift equation postcompose with epsilon_X shifted by one. NatTrans.shift_app_comm changes the left side to the alpha shift square, while functoriality of translation and inverse cancellation change the right side to its right side. Cancel to obtain the target equation with its original supplied shift structure.

proof_origin.place: The original three-step bounded-stage, sum/cone and ratio plan, now assembled in Lean; K-flat counit comparison, stage naturality and shift cancellation are complete. Bounded normalization and its sum/cone extension are split off.
